items.title: Kevin Huerter had moments with the Pistons before a groin injury forced him to miss most of the playoffs.
items.author: Omari Sankofa II
items.body_excerpt:
Kevin Huerter had moments with the Pistons before a groin injury forced him to miss most of the playoffs. 

Now back on a three-year deal, he's eager to show why he's one of their most complete offensive weapons. 

www.freep.com/story/sports...

items.title: Huerter: "Maybe my greatest skill is making the game easier for the other four guys on the court. On the offensive side of the ball it’s playing with great pace, sometimes without the ball and sometimes with the ball. I’m not a guy who needs a ton of dribbles to be effective."

items.title: Huerter said he had a groin injury during his time in Chicago that was re-aggravated in the playoffs against Orlando. After they were eliminated, he had surgery to clean up the injury. Said it was frustrating that it happened during the postseason, but he's healthy now.
